patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Insightly is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Insightly is narrower/specialist.. Choose HubSpot only if your buying job matches “AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Ma” rather than Insightly's shape. Choose Insightly only if your buying job matches “CRM plus project management for service-oriented SMBs, with automation and AI on higher pl” rather than HubSpot's shape. Workflow advantage: HubSpot leans sales-automation, outbound-sales; Insightly leans field-sales. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — HubSpot documents a broader use-case set; Insightly is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: HubSpot is AI-powered customer platform with free forever CRM, plus paid Smart CRM seats and Sales/Marketing/Service hubs for growing teams.; Insightly is CRM plus project management for service-oriented SMBs, with automation and AI on higher plans..
- Company-size focus: HubSpot (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Insightly (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: HubSpot-leaning sales-automation, outbound-sales, high-volume-lead-management vs Insightly-leaning field-sales.
- Researched limits: HubSpot — Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.; Insightly — Pricing confidence medium for Insightly — re-verify first-party page before purchase decisions..

Limitations — HubSpot: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats.; Sales Hub Professional starts at $100/month per seat on the Product & Services Catalog and the Sales product page (re-checked 2026-08-18). HubSpot’s Sales pricing page also shows $90/mo/seat billed annually vs $100 monthly, plus required Professional onboarding ($1,500). Starter marketing prices show new-customer discounts (*).; Insightly: Pricing confidence medium for Insightly — re-verify first-party page before purchase decisions.; Confirm live Insightly checkout; packaging can change..

Poor-fit cases: HubSpot is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Smart CRM / Customer Platform seats and Sales Hub seats are separate ladders with different list prices; buying 'HubSpot' often means mixing Free CRM, Smart CRM seats, and hub seats. · Insightly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing confidence medium for Insightly — re-verify first-party page before purchase decisions. · Avoid HubSpot if you actually need Insightly's motion (CRM plus project management for service-oriented SMBs, with automation and AI on)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
